topic.readerProblem: Compare Geneo credit plans without mistaking a nominal credit ratio for the cost of a guaranteed AI response.
topic.connection: Supports an AEOeye reader budgeting recurring AI visibility checks and agency capacity.

assessment: The final Geneo Pricing (2026): Credits, Plans, and Cost per AI Check guide answers the buying question with official documentation, reproducible arithmetic, explicit documentation-only limits, and a practical monitoring-scope decision. It does not claim product use or outcome testing.

sources.supports: Official free, Pro and agency plan prices and included credits.

checks: Opened every named official source and reconciled the visible amount, currency, billing cadence, allowance, and quote status with the final article.
Recomputed every worked example from the published inputs and kept uncertainty or checkout caveats adjacent to the arithmetic.
Read the final opening, tables, internal links, limitations, conclusion, and all four FAQs for consistency and documentation-only disclosure.
Confirmed the final article contains no claim of paid-account use, output-quality testing, ranking result, or guaranteed product outcome.
